fr3_replacement.requirement: Surface four governance-note metadata keys directly inside stampConstraintsBlock, WITHOUT widening the shared resolveHoldProvenance
fr3_replacement.description: CORRECTED at EXEC (evidence 4298bd82-d59d-4ac6-b585-eb6aaf206915): the original FR-3 widened the shared resolveHoldProvenance (lib/fleet/claim-eligibility.cjs) with four new keys (human_action_note, human_action_reason, human_action_required, needs_coordinator_review_reason). EXEC-phase TESTING found this had an unaudited, fleet-wide consequence: resolveHoldProvenance is not purely descriptive -- scripts/post-merge-handoff-orchestrator.js's classifyState() and lib/fleet/belt-census.cjs both gate real behavior (auto-handoff refusal, belt census bucketing) on whatever it resolves, and the widening moved 64 live SDs into a newly-resolved hold, 11 non-terminal, stalling their auto-handoff -- permanently, since none of the four keys had a release-check path. resolveHoldProvenance is REVERTED to its original 6-key precedence chain (requires_human_action_reason, not_worker_claimable_reason, review_hold_reason, dispatch_ineligible_reason, pilot_throwaway, deferred_by); the HOLD_REASON_KEYS export is removed. Instead, stampConstraintsBlock (lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs) reads the four keys DIRECTLY -- the same pattern already used there for the solomon_* fields -- rendering each as its own CONSTRAINTS line (with the same control-char sanitization applied to every other rendered field) with zero effect on any dispatch/handoff/belt gate. QF-20260904-724's ORIGINAL problem (the dashboard rendering 5 specific SDs' holds as 'no reason recorded (bare flag)') remains UNFIXED by this SD -- that is a genuinely separate fix (widening the DASHBOARD's own render path, or resolveHoldProvenance itself after a full consumer audit this SD did not have scope to perform) and QF-20260904-724 should stay open for a session that does that audit properly.
acceptance_criteria: AC-7: stampConstraintsBlock renders a distinct CONSTRAINTS line for metadata carrying only human_action_note, only human_action_reason, only needs_coordinator_review_reason (real text each), and for metadata carrying only human_action_required=true (a fixed 'Human action required: true' line) -- verified against the actual rendered row.body, not a mocked stamper call

AC-20 (regression guard): resolveHoldProvenance(metadata) returns null for metadata carrying ONLY one of the four keys above -- proving the shared, gate-affecting resolver was NOT widened, so scripts/post-merge-handoff-orchestrator.js's classifyState() and lib/fleet/belt-census.cjs see byte-identical behavior to before this SD

AC-9 (scope note, no longer a drift-detection test): this SD does not attempt to make QF-20260904-724's original dashboard bare-flag problem self-detecting, since fixing it requires a consumer audit outside this SD's scope; QF-20260904-724 remains open

ts5_replacements.scenario: stampConstraintsBlock renders each of the four governance-note keys directly, one CONSTRAINTS line per key
ts5_replacements.given: target SD metadata carries human_action_note, human_action_reason, needs_coordinator_review_reason (each tested separately) or human_action_required=true
ts5_replacements.then: the corresponding labeled CONSTRAINTS line appears in row.body, sanitized the same way as every other rendered field

ts5_replacements.given: metadata carrying only one of the four governance-note keys
ts5_replacements.then: it returns null -- the shared, gate-affecting resolver is unchanged from its pre-SD 6-key behavior

acceptance_criteria_index_4_replacement: The four governance-note keys (human_action_note/human_action_reason/human_action_required/needs_coordinator_review_reason) reach the worker via the CONSTRAINTS block with zero effect on resolveHoldProvenance or any consumer that gates on it (auto-handoff, belt census) -- QF-20260904-724's original dashboard-display problem remains open for a separately-scoped fix
